body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> Celestron(www.celestron.com) presented its telescope 'CGE Pro Series' at the CES 2009.

The CGE Pro computerized series is Celestron's newsest line of observatory class German equatorial telescope offered with 9.25, 11 and 14 apeture Schmidt-Cassegrain optical tubes, they all come mounted on the new state of the art CGE Pro GoTo mount.
